_readme: PAYLOAD FIXTURE for `src/sources/listing-api.ts`.
One listing run, stored as that adapter's `fetch` returned it, so
`parse` and `toCanonical` can be driven over it with no network —
which is what keeps the cases beside that module in the fully
isolated default suite.
An envelope, not the payload itself: everything the adapter is
handed sits under `payload`, and this key does not. A header
written into the payload would reach `parse` as though the source
had answered with it.
AUTHORED HERE rather than recorded from a source, which is the
law for every fixture in this repository: a payload pasted in
whole is the easiest way to commit somebody else's data by
accident. The catalogue below is invented, its host is under
`.invalid` — a name reserved so it can never resolve — and the
subject matter is deliberately nobody's.
Three records under two endpoints, and each one is a case:
`atlas-0007` is the ordinary reading, with markup a selector
reaches into; `atlas-0008` states an empty `permalink`, which is
the URL a `documents` row stores as NULL rather than as `''`; and
`beacon-0142` carries no `content` member at all, which is the
capture that yields an empty body and is kept anyway.
